user_full_name.description: User's full name for 'From:' field in outgoing messages.

user_email.description: User's primary email address for outgoing messages.

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname for sending outgoing mail.

imap_host.description: IMAP server hostname for accessing mail folders.

folder_collections.description: List of folder collections; each has a name and folder list (IMAP paths).

signature_file.description: Path to file containing message signature (prepended to outgoing messages).

sendmail_command.description: Command to use for local mail delivery if SMTP is not used.

feature_list.description: Space-separated list of features; prepend 'no-' to disable a feature (e.g., 'no-suspend').

newmail_check_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for checking new mail (minimum 150 per Alpine docs).

folder_index_sort.description: Sort order for folder index view (e.g., 'date', 'subject', 'from', 'reverse').

threading_enabled.description: Enable message threading in folder index.

editor.description: Editor used for message composition (only 'pico' is supported).

mailcap_path.description: Semicolon-separated list of mailcap file paths for MIME handling.

mime_types_file.description: Path to system MIME type mapping file.

password_cache.description: Path to password cache file (if compiled with support).

smime_directory.description: Directory for S/MIME keys, certificates, and CA store.

xoauth2_server.description: OAuth2 service provider name (e.g., 'Gmail'). All XOAUTH2 variables must be set together.

xoauth2_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID for XOAUTH2 auth.

xoauth2_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret for XOAUTH2 auth.

restricted_mode.description: Enable restricted demo mode (limits save/export and restricts recipients).

function_keys.description: Use function-key commands instead of single-letter mnemonics (like alpinef).

suspend_allowed.description: Enable ^Z and SIGTSTP suspension (not recommended in non-interactive use).
